reuseNotes: Original 32 successful cases were not repeated.

After changing only the two draft report reviewedAt strings from +00:00 to Z, the first 12 successful assertions about item/scoring/eligibility/hash and batch input guard logic remain applicable; 24 failures were rerun and passed.

PostgreSQL first 10 successes remain original successes. The two bad table-name assertions were repaired and rerun. Fixture create became an idempotent upsert selecting the same existing synthetic actor.
CLI-only changes to manifest byte binding and receipt protection were rechecked with the affected CLI case; no previous failed invocation is relabelled successful.
